meta.description: Canonical catalog of all FileMaker Pro script steps, organised by category. Use this for prototype/syntax lookups before fetching live docs. doc_url points to the authoritative Claris Help Centre page for each step.
meta.last_updated: 2026-06 (v1.5 — removed stale Execute SQL Query by Natural Language and duplicate Perform SQL Query by Natural Language from Miscellaneous; fixed Editing Insert Embedding and Found Sets Perform Semantic Find entries)
meta.update_instructions: Re-fetch https://help.claris.com/en/pro-help/content/script-steps-reference.html and compare category listings. Add new steps, update slugs, bump last_updated.
meta.note: Syntax uses [] for required fields/options and {} for optional. Steps marked platform list restrictions (Pro, Server, Go, WebDirect, Cloud).

steps.name: Perform Script
steps.syntax: Perform Script [ Specified: From list ; "ScriptName" ; Parameter: value ]
steps.purpose: Runs a named script in the current or another file, optionally passing a parameter

steps.name: Perform Script on Server
steps.syntax: Perform Script on Server [ Wait for completion: On/Off ; Specified: From list ; "ScriptName" ; Parameter: value ]
steps.purpose: Runs a script on FileMaker Server (server-side scripting)

steps.name: Pause/Resume Script
steps.purpose: Pauses the current script for user input or a fixed duration

steps.name: Exit Script
steps.purpose: Ends the current script and optionally sets a script result accessible via Get(ScriptResult)

steps.name: Halt Script
steps.purpose: Stops all scripts in the call stack immediately

steps.name: If
steps.purpose: Begins a conditional block; executes enclosed steps only when condition is true

steps.name: Else If
steps.purpose: Additional condition branch within an If block

steps.name: Else
steps.purpose: Default branch executed when no If/Else If condition is true

steps.name: End If
steps.purpose: Closes an If block

steps.name: Loop
steps.purpose: Begins a loop block that repeats until an Exit Loop If or Go to Record exits it

steps.name: Exit Loop If
steps.purpose: Exits the enclosing Loop when condition is true

steps.name: End Loop
steps.purpose: Closes a Loop block and returns execution to the Loop step

steps.name: Allow User Abort
steps.purpose: Controls whether users can stop the script with Escape/Cancel

steps.name: Set Error Capture
steps.purpose: When On, suppresses FileMaker error dialogs so scripts can handle errors programmatically

steps.name: Set Variable
steps.syntax: Set Variable [ $name ; Value: expression ; Repetition: n ]
steps.purpose: Creates or sets a local ($var) or global ($$var) variable

steps.name: Install OnTimer Script
steps.syntax: Install OnTimer Script [ Interval: seconds ; Specified: From list ; "ScriptName" ; Parameter: value ]
steps.purpose: Installs a script that runs repeatedly on a timer interval

steps.purpose: Begins a database transaction (changes committed or rolled back as a unit)

steps.name: Commit Transaction
steps.purpose: Commits an open transaction, making all changes permanent

steps.name: Revert Transaction
steps.purpose: Rolls back an open transaction, discarding all changes since Open Transaction

steps.name: Perform Semantic Find
steps.syntax: Perform Semantic Find [ Table::EmbeddingField ; Query Embedding: value ; Top K: n ]
steps.purpose: Finds the top K records most semantically similar to a query embedding vector
steps.notes: Query by: Embedding (vector) or Image (pass a container field or variable containing an image — the step generates the query embedding internally). Save result option: set a variable to receive a JSON array of objects with recordID and cosineSimilarity scores for each matched record. Normalised embedding vectors required for accurate results. Both query and stored embeddings must have identical dimensions.

steps.name: Save Records as JSONL
steps.purpose: Saves records to a specified JSONL file; each line is a JSON object representing a record. Used to output record data for fine-tuning a model.
steps.syntax: Save Records as JSONL [ No dialog ; File: <path> ; Fields: <field list> ]
steps.notes: Format for fine-tuning On: requires three explicit prompts — System Prompt (optional), User Prompt, Assistant Prompt. Format for fine-tuning Off: Completion Field required; all other fields become user prompt content. Container fields are skipped (Off mode) or exported as filename string (On mode). Compatibility: not supported on FileMaker Go or WebDirect.

steps.name: Trigger Claris Connect Flow
steps.purpose: Trigger a Claris Connect flow from a FileMaker script.
steps.syntax: Trigger Claris Connect Flow [ Flow Name: <name> ; Parameters: <JSON> ; Response Target: <field/variable> ]
steps.notes: Passes JSON parameters to a Claris Connect flow and optionally captures the response. Requires Claris Connect configured and the file hosted on FileMaker Server. Not available in FileMaker Go or WebDirect.

steps.name: Set Session Identifier
steps.purpose: Assign a custom identifier string to the current session for use with Get(SessionIdentifier).
steps.notes: Does not change Get(UserName). Only meaningful for hosted files — used to tag sessions for logging or tracking. Pairs with Get(SessionIdentifier) to retrieve the value in calculations or scripts.

steps.name: Configure AI Account
steps.syntax: Configure AI Account [ Account Name: name ; Model Provider: OpenAI/Anthropic/Custom ; API key: key ; Endpoint: url ]
steps.purpose: Configures a named AI account for use with AI functions and script steps

steps.name: Configure Machine Learning Model
steps.syntax: Configure Machine Learning Model [ Operation: Vision/Regression ; Name: name ; From: field ]
steps.purpose: Loads a Core ML model for use with ComputeModel or PredictFromModel (macOS/iOS only)

steps.name: Configure Prompt Template
steps.purpose: Set up a named prompt template to use in other AI script steps.
steps.syntax: Configure Prompt Template [ Account Name: <name> ; Template Name: <name> ; Template: <text> ]
steps.notes: Template Types: SQL Query, Find Request, RAG Prompt. Template constants: :schema: (DDL schema), :question: (user prompt), :context: (RAG context), :sql_query: (generated SQL), :sql_results: (query results), :date_format: (date format string). Template names are case-sensitive. Templates are session-scoped and cleared on file close.

steps.name: Configure RAG Account
steps.syntax: Configure RAG Account [ Account Name: name ; API key: key ; Endpoint: url ]
steps.purpose: Configure a named RAG account connecting to a FileMaker Server AI Model Server knowledge store.
steps.notes: Endpoint URL must end with /. API Key obtained from FileMaker Server Admin Console. Verify SSL Certificates option behaves the same as Configure AI Account. Account is cleared on file close (session-scoped).

steps.name: Configure Regression Model
steps.syntax: Configure Regression Model [ Action: Train/Load/Unload ; Model Name: name ; ... ]
steps.purpose: Trains or loads a regression model for use with PredictFromModel
steps.notes: Actions: Train (uses Random Forest algorithm), Save, Load, Unload. Train parameters: numTrees (default 10), maxDepth (10), minSamplesSplit (2), numFeatures (-1 = all), maxFeatures (1 = sqrt of features). Models remain in memory until Unload action or session end. Pairs with PredictFromModel function.

steps.name: Fine-Tune Model
steps.purpose: Fine-tune a model using a training data set.
steps.syntax: Fine-Tune Model [ Account Name: <name> ; Base Model: <model> ; Training Data: <field/variable> ; Output Model: <field/variable> ]
steps.notes: Training data source: Table or JSONL File. Uses LoRA (Low-Rank Adaptation) technique. ONLY supported on OpenAI or AI Model Server running on Apple silicon Mac — not available for other providers or Linux/Windows hosts. Fine-tune parameters: max_steps (1000), learning_rate (2e-4), lora_layers (4), batch_size (1), fine_tuned_model_name. AI Model Server prefixes model name with fm-mlx- (e.g. my-model → fm-mlx-my-model). Response Target returns job JSON with status 'queued' — training is asynchronous; monitor via Admin Console. Pairs with Save Records as JSONL for training data preparation.

steps.name: Generate Response from Model
steps.purpose: Facilitate multistep agentic interaction between your custom app and AI models, supporting built-in and custom function tool calls.
steps.syntax: Generate Response from Model [ Account Name: <name> ; Model: <model> ; User Prompt: <text> ; Agentic mode: On/Off ; Messages: <variable> ; Save Message History To: <variable> ; Message History Count: <n> ; Instructions: <text> ; Tool Definitions: <JSON> ; Temperature: <value> ; Stream: On/Off ; Perform JavaScript in Web Viewer: <viewer> ; Response Target: <field/variable> ]
steps.notes: Agentic mode On: enables full multi-round tool execution. Agentic mode Off: stops after first tool call and returns tool call JSON (useful for debugging). Built-in tool definitions: execute_sql (generates and runs SQL; append DDL schema to parameter description), retrieve_image (fetches image from container field via SQL ROWID). Custom function tools: name must exactly match FileMaker custom function name; parameters must be in same order and count, always typed as string. Stream On: incremental delivery; target field must be on current layout. Messages/Save Message History To/Message History Count: manage multi-turn conversation history. Temperature range varies by model provider. Error: 'No tool call exists for the prompt' when model doesn't call a tool. Error: 'Function not found' when custom function is missing. Full platform compatibility.

steps.name: Insert Embedding
steps.syntax: Insert Embedding [ Account Name: name ; Embedding Model: model ; Source Field: field ; Target Field: field ]
steps.purpose: Generates an embedding vector and stores it in a container field

steps.name: Insert Embedding in Found Set
steps.purpose: Insert embedding vectors for all records in the current found set.
steps.syntax: Insert Embedding in Found Set [ Account Name: <name> ; Embedding Model: <model> ; Input: <field> ; Target: <field> ]
steps.notes: Parameters JSON keys: MaxRecPerCall (default 20, max 500), MaxRetryPerWorker (5), MaxWaitPerRetry (60000 ms, OpenAI only), TruncateTokenLimit (8185), TruncateEnabled (1), RetryOnError (0). RetryOnError overrides the Continue on error option.

steps.name: Perform Find by Natural Language
steps.purpose: Get a found set by sending a natural language prompt and layout fields to a model.
steps.syntax: Perform Find by Natural Language [ Account Name: <name> ; Model: <model> ; Prompt: <text> ; Response Target: <field/variable> ]
steps.notes: Get options: Found Set (updates current found set), Found Set as JSON (Data API format), Find Request as JSON (debug — inspect the find criteria without performing the find). Uses GetFieldsOnLayout to determine which fields are sent to the model. Supports context_prompt parameter key for date/time context. Cannot perform finds requiring aggregate functions (e.g. find the record with the highest value in a field). Returns error 401 when no records match.

steps.name: Perform RAG Action
steps.purpose: Add or remove data in a RAG knowledge space, or send a prompt to a RAG space for context-aware AI responses.
steps.syntax: Perform RAG Action [ RAG Account Name: <name> ; AI Account Name: <name> ; Action: Add Data / Send Prompt / Remove Data ; Input: <field/file/container/variable> ; Prompt Template Name: <name> ; Response Target: <field/variable> ]
steps.notes: Add Data actions: From Text, From File, From File (Async), From Container, From Container (Async). Async is recommended for large PDFs. WebDirect ignores Input File path and opens Insert dialog instead. Send Prompt: uses both a RAG Account and an AI Account; supports context_prompt parameter key; optional Prompt Template Name. Remove Data: pass JSON with id array; irreversible — warn users to retain originals. PDF with encryption cannot be added. Adding a PDF with the same filename removes the existing entry.

steps.name: Perform SQL Query by Natural Language
steps.purpose: Send a natural language prompt and database schema to a model, which generates and runs SQL queries to return a result.
steps.syntax: Perform SQL Query by Natural Language [ Account Name: <name> ; Model: <model> ; Prompt: <text> ; Data Tables: <tables> ; Action: Query ; Response Target: <field/variable> ]
steps.notes: Action options: Query (run SQL and return data), Query for Data Only (suppress column headers), Get SQL (return all generated SQL without executing), Get First SQL Only (first SQL only — saves tokens), Get DDL (returns schema only, no model call). Data Tables: From list (select in dialog), By name (field/variable), By DDL (custom DDL for fine-grained schema control). Options: From list or By JSON data (dynamic configuration). Field comments in Manage Database dialog are sent to the model as schema context. Compatibility partial for Server, Cloud, Data API, Custom Web Publishing — Perform JavaScript in Web Viewer not supported server-side.

steps.name: Perform Semantic Find
steps.syntax: Perform Semantic Find [ Table::EmbeddingField ; Query Embedding: value ; Top K: n ]
steps.purpose: Finds the top K records most semantically similar to a query embedding vector
steps.notes: Query by: Embedding (vector) or Image (pass a container field or variable containing an image — the step generates the query embedding internally). Save result option: set a variable to receive a JSON array of objects with recordID and cosineSimilarity scores for each matched record. Normalised embedding vectors required for accurate results. Both query and stored embeddings must have identical dimensions.

steps.name: Set AI Call Logging
steps.purpose: Control logging of AI calls made from the current file.
steps.syntax: Set AI Call Logging [ On/Off ; Mode: Standard/Verbose ; Truncate Messages: On/Off ]
steps.notes: Verbose mode: logs embedding vectors, token counts, semantic find return count, and cosine similarity scores. Truncate Messages: shortens verbose output for large embedding vectors. Standard mode logs prompts and responses without embedding detail.
